stem: The result of Cleary's experiment supports which idea about déjà vu?

options.label: F
options.text: But this was proved untrue when a 2006 experiment at the University of Leeds, a world leader in déjà vu research, demonstrated that the blind also experience déjà vu.

options.label: G
options.text: One early explanation of déjà vu suggested that the eyes were sending messages to the brain at different speeds.

options.label: H
options.text: When a person enters the new place, the neurons processing it may misfire and retrieve details that overlap a previous experience.

options.label: J
options.text: In 2007, neuroscientists at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) researched the hippocampus, the part of the brain thought to be responsible for learning and memory.

visual_elements: Text with question and four answer choices labeled F, G, H, J in italic font
